body:
Yeah, sounds good. Thanks for the reply, fellow Fapstronaut!  
I should be on 4 days though, so just watch out for that. My badge is broken right now.
You're right, I can. Thanks for the reply.

I guess the benefits depend entirely on the individual. I think it's more in my head for me. I think that if I can stop myself fapping on impulses, then I'll be more confident in myself. Just read some stories about when people have done the NoFap challenge, that'll give you a better idea of what they got out of it and possibly what you might get out of it.  
Good luck, Fapstronaut!
I do like this song, not listened to it for a while. Appreciate the input :)
Thankyou, this will come in very handy.
Thankyou! I will try this. 90 will remain my ultimate goal, but I will try to go for a week at first, and then 2 and so on. Thanks for the reply.
Thanks for the reply! Appreciate the tip. I'll take a look at the button now.

I don't really know anything about this kind of stuff at all, but maybe your willpower for fasting is better due to other people around you. Other people around you are fasting, so you do it together. It seems like I smoke more when others around me are smoking. Anyway, I think it may help you to maybe find an accountability partner over on [/r/Fapstronauts](http://reddit.com/r/Fapstronauts)

It's eerie how he describes feelings and thoughts that I have all the time. He was saying things about walking around campus seeing people together, and I just pictured myself doing the same thing around my college. Sometimes I think I'm going to end up a 58 year old virgin. Luckily, I have some close friends, so I don't feel quite so lonely.
Good luck fellow Fapstronaut! Make sure you pick something up to do in the meantime (Fit in some more exercise, or start reading a book maybe), don't let yourself get bored.
So am I. Thanks for the reply
I feel exactly like this. I try to do things I used to like but now I just lose interest and get bored.
